proposals.evidence: CDIAL 986 asmad gives Prakrit amhe and Hindi/Bhojpuri ham, Gujarati ame we. Bhili hamũ fits the plural-pronoun family with final nasal vowel retained; exclusivity is an elicited local distinction, not a reconstructed property of asmad. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: hamũ.
